title: SleeveSignal
description: V3: a single strategy SLEEVE's contribution to the multi-strategy book — TARGET POSITIONS (not a cross-sectional ranking). One sleeve = one economic edge (S1 pairs / S2 macro-tilt / S3 event / S4 core). This is the POSITION-form sleeve input to the risk_manager combiner, alongside the ranking-form `aggregated_signal` (S1/S2). Emitted by e.g. ml/src/service/dividend_sleeve.py::build_sleeve_signal (H9 dividend run-up). INFORMATION for risk_manager (which nets sleeves, applies vol-targeting H4 + regime gate H5 + limits + hedge), NOT a trade command.

sleeve.description: Which strategy sleeve produced this. P&L attribution and the correlation cap key on this.

strategy.description: Concrete strategy id within the sleeve (e.g. dividend_runup).

as_of.description: Decision timestamp (past-only). String, not strictly date-time: serving code may emit a space-separated tz-aware timestamp.

market_neutral.description: True if the sleeve intends the book to carry no net market beta (hedge applied by risk_manager).

positions.description: Target positions. May be empty (sleeve abstains today). Weights are book fractions, signed by leg.

ticker.description: Instrument; index tickers (e.g. IMOEX, MOEXOG) are allowed on hedge legs.

weight.description: Signed book fraction. Long > 0, short < 0; hedge legs carry the sleeve's SUGGESTED hedge (risk_manager may replace it).

leg.description: Role of this position. 'hedge' is a suggested index hedge the risk_manager may re-derive (e.g. sector instead of market).

gross.description: Sleeve self-reported gross exposure (sum of |weight| over all legs).
